metadata.title: Is Adivasi becoming Vote Bank at national level | आदिवासी वोट बैंक और राष्ट्रीय राजनीति
metadata.description: The election campaign for assembly election in Gujarat is in full swing now. The ruling BJP, new entrant AAP and Congress, all are focusing on tribal votes. It is quite obvious as tribal voter has influence on many seats apart from the 27 ST reserve seats in the state. But it's not only the sate of Gujarat, where tribals have influence as far as electoral politics is concerned. But tribals vote bank was never discussed as an influential power like Dalits, OBCs or Muslims. In this discussion we try to understand if the situation is changing and tribal communities are also becoming a vote bank at national level. Our guest is known political analyst Sanjay Kumar of CSDS.
